# Third-party software

The distributed App includes **codex-auth 0.3.1**, by Loongphy, under the MIT
license. Its unmodified native binaries are fetched from the published
`@loongphy/codex-auth-darwin-{arm64,x64}` packages and verified against pinned
SHA-512 archive digests in `scripts/vendor.py`. Its complete copyright and
license notice is included in `codex-auth.LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/Loongphy/codex-auth/tree/v0.3.1

Codex Eyes' interface, animations, integration layer, session index and tests
are original code. The following projects informed research, without shipping
their application code or visual assets:

- https://github.com/KevinKE93/Codex-Monitor
- https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar
- https://github.com/lovach/Lunavect
- https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage

Codex Eyes is an independent community project, not an OpenAI product.

The project-owner-supplied application icon is covered separately by
`Assets/NOTICE.md` (included as `AppIcon-NOTICE.md` in the App). It contains an
OpenAI mark; the source MIT license does not grant rights to that mark or image.
